name: Fortified Maze and Elderbrain
description:
Fortified Maze:

Value: 2000
Rarity: 90

Size 1: guarded by 5x3 Minotaurs, gives 1 Red Dragon (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 5x6 Minotaurs, gives 2 Red Dragons (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 5x9 Minotaurs, gives 3 Red Dragons (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 5x12 Minotaurs, gives 4 Red Dragons (15%)

Lower-left stack of Minotaurs has a 50% chance to be upgraded.

Elderbrain:

Value: 2000
Rarity: 60
Zone limit: 1

The bank generates only on Subterrea, Lava and Sand terrains. Alhoons in this bank can hypnotize player's troops with total health up to 20 + 25*(Alhoon count).

Size 1: guarded by 5x4 Alhoons, gives 1 Red Dragon (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 5x8 Alhoons, gives 2 Red Dragons (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 5x12 Alhoons, gives 3 Red Dragons (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 5x16 Alhoons, gives 4 Red Dragons (15%)

Fortified Maze and Elderbrain substitute Griffin Conservatory from the base game.
author: wnukos, Kurek (graphics)
